reactionTime.title: Reaction Time Test
reactionTime.shortDescription: Click as fast as you can when the screen changes!
reactionTime.description: Click as quickly as possible the moment the screen turns green. Test your reaction speed.

memoryTest.title: Sequence Memory Test
memoryTest.shortDescription: Remember the flashing color sequence and press them in the exact order!
memoryTest.description: Try to perfectly memorize the increasingly long patterns. What are the limits of your short-term memory?

aimTest.title: Aim Test
aimTest.shortDescription: Aim and click on targets appearing on the screen quickly!
aimTest.description: Accurately and quickly aim and click 31 randomly generated targets. Measures your reaction speed and accuracy.

typingTest.title: Typing Speed Test
typingTest.shortDescription: Type the given sentences quickly and accurately for 60 seconds to measure your WPM (Words Per Minute) and accuracy!
typingTest.description: Test your typing speed (WPM), CPM (Characters Per Minute), and accuracy by typing English words. Challenge your precise typing skills.
